title: Add per-reader worktree/fallback tests for records branch move (D111)
summary: Retry of job 20261026-150607-85mv: the production move of records/ readers to the athena/records worktree is kept as in the accepted reading; the rejection was for missing per-reader tests and a missing forecast run. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier. The retry adds a test per reader with the worktree present and with it absent, a status and forecast scratch-checkout test, and fixes the minor findings.

defaults_applied.how: Full cargo test, fmt, clippy pass.
Criteria require tests that show worktree versus in-tree results per reader.
Criteria check readers return worktree records and status/forecast succeed.
Common-dir derivation fixed in all readers, not just one.
Decisions and changelog written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The earlier attempt's production changes are not in the repository, so the producer redoes them per the accepted reading before adding tests.
The forecast test can run offline against fixtures.
The site generator stays unchanged and out of scope.

acceptance_criteria.text: In crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs, for each moved reader (Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, xtask walltime reader, introspect walks, status, forecasting, scoring, retry carry, auditor, audit, proposals, backtest, land_pr) a named test puts different records in the worktree and in in-tree records/ and asserts the worktree's records are returned. Run cargo test --locked.
For each of the same readers, a named test with no worktree asserts it falls back to in-tree records/ and returns the same result as before. Run cargo test --locked.

A test runs the athena binary's status and a forecast on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, and asserts both succeed with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test --locked.
The change description lists every reader found by grep of the code and maps each to its test names, and cites the commands actually run.
backtest.rs and xtask walltime.rs find the git common dir via git's common-dir, not <root>/.git, and a test from a linked worktree checkout finds the records worktree. Run cargo test --locked.

Tests create the records worktree under a temporary state directory, not the real state root; the scoring closures' use of the worktree regardless of the passed head is documented in docs/decisions.md and tested.

The xtask records_reader_scan still fails on planted reads, and allow-list entries are narrowed to call sites where practical. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan and confirm a nonzero number of tests ran.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and the full cargo test --locked pass; xtask/src/site.rs is untouched.
CHANGELOG.md records the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.

departures: Large reader inventory and redoing discarded production changes raise cost and time above the reference.
